column1: # Lane L3 ledger (docs/plans/2026-11-22-dm0b-scc-cut.md section 5, row L3 "batch families").
# One row per declaration of each of the 60 root files the layout TSV assigns to
# batchinst / batchflow / finalize / batchassemble that still existed at HEAD: 883
# declarations, struct fields and interface methods included (2 further scope files are
#   record row_id source_file kind symbol source_line target_file target_symbol
#   present           unchanged: its comment-free token stream is identical at HEAD and now
#   requalified       identical after the lane's rename map (old root name -> package-
#                     qualified destination name) or after a promoted embedded-field
#                     selector follows its type's new name
#   retired           the root declaration is deleted; target_symbol/target_file is the
#                     pre-existing destination declaration it aliased, and every former
#   retired_adapter   as retired, and the forwarder was curried: each former call site
#                     inlines exactly the arguments the wrapper supplied
#   port              body changed by an inlined curried adapter (the deleted wrapper
#                     supplied the missing arguments) or by a promoted embedded-field
#                     selector that follows its type's new name
#   blank             var _ compile-time assertion (no identity of its own)
# hit = sha256_16 over the whitespace-normalised HEAD source span of the declaration,
# before the rename map is applied (comparison strips comments on both sides).
# Verifier: .rush/tmp/sprint0/l3/ledger.py (scratch, not checked in): token alignment,
# unclaimed-removal, target-existence and unclaimed-addition checks over the scope files
# and every other file the lane touched.
# Documented tolerance classes of this lane:
#   - curried adapters inlined at their call sites: classifyBatchLeaf, batchSpecNodes,
#   - promoted embedded-field selectors renamed with their type alias
#   - three aliases deliberately KEPT as thin root adapters because
#     internal/agent/agent_turn_step.go was at 899 lines and may not grow: the file
#     keeps 900 lines, so isBatchStartedToolResult and isFinalizationCandidate stay in
